result.description: The LumaArc 27Q is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for document editing, dashboard review, and general office use. It features a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel, 75Hz refresh rate, and an anti-glare matte finish for comfortable all-day viewing. The display includes HDMI, DisplayPort, and USB-C inputs, along with a low-blue-light mode and adjustable stand. It is not intended as a gaming or workstation-focused display, but as a practical everyday monitor for home offices and small business setups.
